title: SERVER-DEPLOY-1: the tick Worker deploys main itself and verifies the live code, so no deploy runs from a local checkout
body:
**Owner:** Staff (platform)
**Trigger:** every tick, when the merged main sha differs from the deployed sha of a live worker
**Done check:** grep:seed/worker/src/selfdeploy.js::deployFromMain
**Status:** closed

Found 2026-11-14: deploy-workers and deploy-site run only on GitHub Actions (refused) or from a session with a Cloudflare token, so merged code is not live until a code agent deploys it. The tick Worker must compare the deployed version tag with main, fetch the worker's modules from GitHub at that sha, upload them through the Cloudflare API with a scoped token bound as a Worker secret, verify byte-identity and /health, record ops/deploys evidence in D1, and roll back to the previous version on a failed probe. Closing probe: /api/v1/status reports deployed_sha equal to main for every live worker within one tick of a merge, with no session involved.

**Disposition:** shelved (ttl, 2026-11-21T18:12:26Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** open 156.9 hours (limit 6 hours) and no loop closed it (SLA-8H-1). Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).
